sourceDependency: DUB-17 frozen Theorem 2.6 and DUB-18 Corollary 8.2 -> higher symmetric-power continuation -> potential automorphy plus modular Galois association -> actual primitive form coefficient number field/integral Hecke algebra -> integral modular symbols, injective period map and the actual Hecke comparison.
routeDecision: Use the already proved MatrixPolynomialAction, HomogeneousMonomialBasis and HomogeneousCoefficientChange for the original binary coefficients. Transpose changes the existing column substitution to the right row substitution. Avoid the external Dickson-trace, rational canonical form, general representation-category and unrelated Gamma1 Hecke frameworks where native original-object proofs suffice. Construct the period pairing for the original Gamma0 cusp forms and compare their existing operators.
selectedAdaptations: Only the free-algebra pairing transfer, degree-zero divisor kernel span, four rational-cusp evaluations and the actual modular-symbol finite-generation proof are adapted. Existing project matrix substitution and monomial bases replace the external coefficient framework. The Gamma1 Hecke implementation, Dickson trace theory, representation-category splitting and general character machinery are not ported.
discharged: The original degree-zero cusp divisors are generated by actual unimodular cusp pairs. The existing homogeneous polynomial action, transposed to the source right action, and its original finite monomial basis supply the actual integral coefficients. The finite-index coinvariant tensor is therefore a finite integral modular-symbol module, without a supplied spanning family or lattice. For the original Gamma0 cusp space and original positive-index cuspHeckeLinear operators, an injective period pairing and actual adjointness imply finite integral Hecke algebra and operator integrality. Neither operator commutativity nor finite cycles are premises.
remaining: The actual period map, its injectivity and the adjointness of the original Hecke operators are still to be constructed. The resulting coefficient-field arithmetic does not itself construct the modular Galois representation. The residual image, prescribed unitary arithmetic, nonzero Hecke localization/Galois realization, crystalline/Selmer dimensions, R=T and higher symmetric-power automorphy remain open. Acceptance remains 16/20; DUB-17-20 are open.
production: Scratch only, excluded from the frozen 4,922-module production verification.
